title: Tableau Resource Saturation
dataSources: Tableau logs (`tableau:httpd`, `tableau:vizportal`, `tableau:backgrounder`), REST API, and `workgroup` repository tables via DB Connect.
app: Tableau Server logs via Universal Forwarder; Tableau Server REST API and TSM metrics via HEC; `workgroup` repository via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:httpd
| stats max(cpu_pct) as max_cpu, avg(cpu_pct) as avg_cpu, max(mem_pct) as max_mem by host
| where max_cpu>85 OR max_mem>85
| sort - max_cpu
description: Tracks CPU and memory utilisation on Tableau nodes and flags hosts running hot, which throttle every workload on the node and precede hard failures.
value: A saturated Tableau node degrades all its users at once; catching saturation early drives autoscaling or workload rebalancing before an outage.
implementation: Ingest Tableau host metrics; schedule every 10 minutes and alert when a node sustains high CPU or memory.
visualization: Table of host by peak resource use, heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We watch how hard the Tableau servers are working so more power can be added before they slow down or crash.
